lines.2: Were all the people from school asleep by now?
lines.3: I wondered what everyone did at this hour.
lines.6: Neon lights. Noise. The city's air.
lines.7: Everything I sensed was coated in something like static.
lines.10: A group of four passed by, laughing coarsely.
lines.11: What did any of them find so amusing?
lines.12: I envied how carefree they were.
lines.13: While I waited for the light, the idiot couple clinging to each other beside me suddenly kissed.
lines.15: I climbed the stairs leading to the station.
lines.16: Headlights streamed past at regular intervals.
lines.17: A street musician singing. The sound of the last outbound train. The crowd.
lines.18: Wrapped in it all, I looked down over the city.
lines.20: Technically, I had somewhere to return to. I just didn't want to go back.
lines.21: Someone there was trying to encroach on the inside of my "line."
lines.23: Some worthless man called out to me.
lines.24: So many men like him had approached me before that I knew what he wanted without asking.
lines.25: Apparently, men considered me one of the pretty ones.
lines.30: One threatening look was usually enough to make their kind turn tail and run.
lines.32: I looked up at the sky.
lines.33: The sky over Matsukasa was surprisingly beautiful.
lines.37: --And so the day came to an end.
